name: Helldivers 2
native_kbm_note: The Helldivers wiki's Input Problems page says 'There are currently no plans to add Mouse & Keyboard support to consoles' (helldivers.wiki.gg/wiki/Input_Problems). One PSU article lists Helldivers 2 as PS5 KBM-compatible, but the wiki and community reports contradict it.
notes: IMPORTANT: on PC, stratagems are typed with WASD while holding Ctrl, but the tool sends WASD to the left stick. Use the arrow keys for stratagem inputs; they map to the D-pad and are PC secondary defaults. Dive: PC Alt maps to Circle, but sources disagree on how you dive on PS5 (Circle while sprinting, Circle double-tap, or L3 tap). Weapon switching: PC 1/2/3 select slots, but PS5 Triangle (tap) cycles weapons, so 1 and 2 both press Triangle; support weapon is in the Triangle-hold menu. Melee (F) and aim-mode toggle (MMB) are both R3 on PS5. R held = weapon wheel (Square held) works automatically. Space covers reinforce/climb/skip dialogue (Cross). Camera-side switch omitted because sources conflict.
